failure_symptom: Duplicate transaction replay and float rounding drift corrupt account balances
root_cause: Missing O(1) tx_id idempotency map and binary float fee math
fix_applied: Cache receipts by tx_id and compute fee via Decimal(fee_bps)/Decimal(10000) with ROUND_HALF_UP

failure_symptom: O(N) min/max/sum recalculation over sliding window degrades streaming throughput
root_cause: Scanning window list on every query
fix_applied: Maintain monotonic min/max deques and running sum for O(1) amortized updates

failure_symptom: Recursive DFS critical-path search hits RecursionError or exponential blowup on dense DAGs
root_cause: Recomputing paths without topological dynamic programming
fix_applied: Run Kahn O(V+E) wave sort followed by single-pass forward DP for critical path

task_summary: Build >130k lines/sec log redactor and path guard
failure_symptom: Sequential regex substitutions and string-prefix path checks are slow and bypassable
root_cause: Running N separate regex passes inside loops and using str.startswith on uncanonicalized paths
fix_applied: Pre-compile a single combined named-group regex at module load and enforce Path.resolve().is_relative_to()
